stage: Local implementation and author verification complete; independent QA and PO acceptance pending. Unpublished.
customerJob: Open the saved website conversation beside a customer request and read earlier facts and corrections without losing them after40 messages.
scope: Tenant-scoped self-service website history only; existing managed SMS and voice persistence are unchanged.
Inbox conversation previews link to the protected paged reader; exact current request source links to the same reader.
Model context remains bounded to the last40 messages. Owner pages show20 saved messages with Earlier/Newer navigation.
storageContract: Immutable input batch is saved before model execution, after existing logical AI admission. Completion batch is saved before its CAS head locator.
Head stores at most2000 batch locators; reaching the limit refuses further input instead of evicting earlier history. Each batch is at most40 messages/65536 encoded bytes.
Random stable turnId distinguishes repeated identical questions. Same-intent recovery verifies input hash, tenant and immutable batch; saved completion replay never repeats model/tool actions.
Any unresolved admitted turn blocks a new/reworded turn. An unknown model/tool result remains unconfirmed; it is not retried blindly.
Both pre-quota recovery probe and post-quota admission honor an already-completed result. Concurrent already-spent quota is conservatively retained, not refunded.
Definite quota/admission refusal precedes new conversation writes and is marked not processed; the browser can safely clear its pending receipt.
Existing legacy heads migrate only their retained messages with complete=false. Already-discarded prefixes are not recoverable.
ownerReadContract: Current revocable owner session and exact workspace incarnation required before and after page reads. Cancellation preserves read-only access.
HMAC cursor binds tenant, exact conversation and immutable upper snapshot. No arbitrary storage paths are accepted.
Paged content uses text nodes; customer HTML remains literal text. Unconfirmed replies are labelled separately.
Complete conversation download refuses old missing prefixes, incomplete bounded head census, missing/fenced heads, missing batches or an oversized archive. It never calls a partial export complete.

publicPayloadDelta.turnId: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters persisted with the exact pending request before send. Old clients without it receive a server-generated intent for compatible normal operation.
publicPayloadDelta.recoverTurn: true performs only existing-result lookup/reconciliation; it cannot start an absent model intent.
publicPayloadDelta.compatibilityLimit: An old open widget without the persisted turn identifier cannot use the new explicit saved-reply recovery. Unknown work still blocks further admission.

retentionAndOperations: New Blob store conversation_history must be included in the still-open scoped processor/deletion-support workflow. Customer cancellation retains audit history; this slice adds no destructive admin bypass.
No live hosting/provider/model/email/phone/text/calendar/payment effects were performed. Storage SDK/model wire responses are local protocol fixtures.
This local acceptance does not establish production storage concurrency, representative real-AI quality, managed SMS/voice archiving, full paid-service readiness or launch readiness.
